officialTitle: Alpelisib for PIK3CA-Mutated, Hormone Receptor-Positive Advanced Breast Cancer
setting: Advanced disease after prior endocrine therapy

design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: A total of 572 patients underwent randomization, including 341 patients with confirmed tumor-tissuemutations.
primaryEndpoints: Investigator-assessed PFS in the PIK3CA-mutated cohort
secondaryEndpoints: PFS in the cohort without PIK3CA mutation
design.notes: Two cohorts enrolled according to tumour-tissue PIK3CA mutation status.

clinicalQuestion: Does the PI3Kα-specific inhibitor alpelisib added to fulvestrant improve PFS in endocrine-pretreated, PIK3CA-mutated, HR-positive/HER2-negative advanced breast cancer?

pico.population: HR-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer previously treated with endocrine therapy; primary cohort with tumour-tissue PIK3CA mutation
pico.outcomes: Primary: investigator-assessed PFS in PIK3CA-mutated cohort. Secondary: overall response, safety

arms.label: Alpelisib + fulvestrant
arms.dosing: Alpelisib 300 mg per day; fulvestrant 500 mg every 28 days and once on day 15
arms.doseSourceQuote: we compared alpelisib (at a dose of 300 mg per day) plus fulvestrant (at a dose of 500 mg every 28 days and once on day 15) with placebo plus fulvestrant

publications.title: Alpelisib for PIK3CA-Mutated, Hormone Receptor-Positive Advanced Breast Cancer.
publications.label: Primary analysis

outcomes.sourceQuote: In the cohort of patients with-mutated cancer, progression-free survival at a median follow-up of 20 months was 11.0 months (95% confidence interval [CI], 7.5 to 14.5) in the alpelisib-fulvestrant group, as compared with 5.7 months (95% CI, 3.7 to 7.4) in the placebo-fulvestrant group (hazard ratio for progression or death, 0.65; 95% CI, 0.50 to 0.85; P<0.001)
in the cohort without-mutated cancer, the hazard ratio was 0.85 (95% CI, 0.58 to 1.25; posterior probability of hazard ratio <1.00, 79.4%)

safety.sourceQuote: In the overall population, the most frequent adverse events of grade 3 or 4 were hyperglycemia (36.6% in the alpelisib-fulvestrant group vs. 0.7% in the placebo-fulvestrant group) and rash (9.9% vs. 0.3%).

safety.description: Discontinuation of alpelisib or placebo owing to adverse events
safety.sourceQuote: The percentages of patients who discontinued alpelisib and placebo owing to adverse events were 25.0% and 4.2%, respectively.

strengths: Biomarker-defined primary cohort with a separate non-mutated cohort that supports PIK3CA as a predictive marker
limitations: Prior CDK4/6 inhibitor exposure not described in the abstract, limiting applicability to the current post-CDK4/6 setting
Substantial hyperglycaemia, rash and treatment discontinuation

clinicalImplications.text: Established PIK3CA mutation testing as a route to alpelisib plus fulvestrant after endocrine therapy in HR-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer; the benefit was not evident in the non-mutated cohort.

tumourBoardPearl.text: Check baseline glycaemic status before alpelisib — hyperglycaemia was the dominant grade 3-4 toxicity.

curation.notes: Numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 31091374. The PubMed text strips the italicised gene symbol PIK3CA (e.g. 'with-mutated'); quotes are kept verbatim as retrieved and the gene symbol restored only in the title field.
